g.text: Poimandres
@pmndrs
Boost
Pmndrs is an open source dev collective, but it hasn't always been clear
what that means. We are going through a lot of changes right now as part
of that journey and I want to bring you along.
It all starts with our mission:
"Poimandres is an open source developer collective for creative
technology and developer tooling. We make things for people who make
things because we believe code can be a craft, a creative medium, and a
source of joy. Our projects are sustained through shared effort, mutual
support, and trust."
Followed by our core principles: simplicity, pragmatism, stability and
quality. These have stayed consistent from the beginning of pmndrs over 8
years ago!
So what is changing?
Before we were a self-organized group of developers with a shared
passion and commitment, but this ran its course as people's priorities
changed and passions moved elsewhere. On top of this, sometimes
members would be working of the same idea in parallel or having
competing interests. To keep pmndrs and its current and future libraries
healthy we needed to seriously organize, align on priorities and direct
resources.
